title: How to Build an HR Management System (Skip the $8/Employee BambooHR Bill)
summary: Build a custom HR system with employee profiles, time-off requests, performance reviews, and onboarding — no code needed. Skip $8/employee/month HR SaaS fees with Blink.
body_markdown: Your custom HR system gives you full control over data residency, retention policies, and deletion flows — you are not locked into a third-party vendor's compliance posture. Blink apps deploy in regions that meet GDPR requirements. Review your specific obligations with legal counsel, but the foundation is yours to configure.
